Our Services

Comprehensive Home Healthcare

🕊️
Hospice Care
End-of-Life Support
Book Appointment

About Hospice Care

Hospihome's hospice care focuses entirely on comfort, dignity, and quality of life for patients with terminal illness. Our team manages pain and provides emotional and spiritual support for both patients and families.

Benefits

  • Expert pain and symptom management
  • Emotional and spiritual counseling for family
  • 24/7 nurse availability for emergencies
  • Reduces repeated hospitalizations
  • Maintains patient dignity and autonomy

Who Is This For?

Patients with advanced illness (cancer, heart failure, COPD) who wish to spend remaining time at home in comfort with loved ones.

👴
Elderly Care
Senior Health
Book Appointment

About Elderly Care

Personalized, respectful support for senior citizens to maintain their independence and quality of life — from medication management to daily companionship.

Benefits

  • Daily assistance with hygiene and mobility
  • Medication reminders and management
  • Nutritional support and dietary monitoring
  • Regular health check-ups
  • Social engagement and mental stimulation

Who Is This For?

Senior citizens 60+ who need daily support, and families with elderly parents needing professional assistance.

🏠
Assisted Living
Daily Support
Book Appointment

About Assisted Living

Round-the-clock support for individuals who need help with activities of daily living but prefer to remain in the comfort of their own home.

Benefits

  • 24-hour supervision and care
  • Help with bathing, dressing, grooming
  • Meal preparation and feeding assistance
  • Fall prevention and safety management
  • Emergency response coordination

Who Is This For?

Individuals with physical or cognitive disabilities, post-surgical patients needing constant supervision.

🦴
Ortho Rehab
Bone & Joint Recovery
Book Appointment

About Ortho Rehabilitation

Certified physiotherapists design evidence-based rehabilitation for musculoskeletal conditions and joint replacement surgeries — delivered entirely at home.

Benefits

  • Customized physiotherapy exercises
  • Post-joint replacement rehab (knee, hip, shoulder)
  • Pain management via electrotherapy
  • Faster recovery in home environment
  • Regular progress tracking

Who Is This For?

Post-operative orthopedic patients, arthritis sufferers, and those recovering from fractures.

🧠
Neuro Rehab
Neurological Recovery
Book Appointment

About Neuro Rehabilitation

Specialized programs for patients recovering from strokes, brain injuries, Parkinson's, MS, and other neurological conditions.

Benefits

  • Stroke recovery and motor function restoration
  • Balance training and fall prevention
  • Speech and swallowing therapy coordination
  • Cognitive exercises for memory
  • Family training for home support

Who Is This For?

Stroke survivors, Parkinson's patients, traumatic brain injury cases, and any neurological condition.

🏥
Post-Surgery Care
Surgical Aftercare
Book Appointment

About Post-Surgery Recovery

Comprehensive post-operative care ensuring patients recover safely after any major surgery, with professional monitoring every step of the way.

Benefits

  • Wound care, dressing changes, infection monitoring
  • IV medication administration
  • Vital signs monitoring daily
  • Nutrition and hydration support
  • Coordination with your surgeon

Who Is This For?

Patients discharged after cardiac, abdominal, orthopedic, or any major surgery needing professional home monitoring.

🧘
Physiotherapy
Movement & Pain Relief
Book Appointment

About Physiotherapy

Our expert physiotherapists bring the clinic to your home. Using evidence-based techniques, they target pain relief, mobility improvement, and functional recovery across a wide range of conditions.

Benefits

  • Targeted pain relief through manual therapy
  • Electrotherapy and ultrasound therapy at home
  • Customized exercise programs for each patient
  • Post-fracture and sports injury rehabilitation
  • Faster recovery in familiar surroundings

Who Is This For?

Anyone suffering from back pain, shoulder pain, sports injuries, post-fracture stiffness, or needing regular physiotherapy without the hassle of commuting.

💉
Nurse Consultation
Professional Nursing Care
Book Appointment

About Nurse Consultation

Qualified and experienced nurses available for home visits — providing everything from medication administration to health education, making hospital-level nursing care accessible at home.

Benefits

  • Injections, IV fluids, and medication administration
  • Wound care, dressing changes, stitch removal
  • Vital signs monitoring (BP, sugar, temperature)
  • Catheter and NG tube care
  • Patient and family health education

Who Is This For?

Patients requiring regular injections, dressing changes, or medical monitoring who prefer to avoid hospital visits, and families needing professional nursing guidance.

🌟
Everyday Care
Daily Wellbeing Support
Book Appointment

About Everyday Care

Consistent, compassionate daily support for patients who need routine assistance to maintain quality of life. Our trained caregivers provide structured, reliable help every single day.

Benefits

  • Morning care routine (hygiene, dressing, grooming)
  • Meal preparation and feeding assistance
  • Mobility assistance and gentle exercise
  • Medication reminders and health tracking
  • Emotional companionship and mental stimulation

Who Is This For?

Elderly patients, those with chronic illness, or anyone needing reliable daily support to maintain independence, dignity, and a high quality of life at home.

Meet Our Founders

Led by Compassion & Medical Excellence

Dr. B.R. Patel and Dr. Ravindra Suryathapa founded Hospihome with one powerful vision: every patient deserves hospital-quality care within the comfort and warmth of their own home.

Having witnessed patients struggle with impersonal institutional healthcare, they built Hospihome to be different — rooted in dignity, personalization, and genuine compassion. Based at Shubhashish Family Clinic, New Maninagar, Ahmedabad, their team now serves hundreds of families.

🎯 Our Mission

To deliver compassionate, medically excellent home healthcare that preserves dignity and improves quality of life.

🌟 Our Vision

To become Ahmedabad's most trusted home healthcare brand — making expert care accessible for every family.
